title: Project Alder — Non-Binding Acquisition Term Sheet & Mutual NDA
summary: Confidential M&A exploration term sheet and exclusivity clause restricted to Legal and Executive clearance.
content:
CONFIDENTIAL LEGAL RECORD — PROJECT ALDER TERM SHEET & MUTUAL NDA

Target Entity: Alder Compliance Systems Inc. (Synthetic)
Indicative Enterprise Valuation Range: $42.0M – $46.5M
Exclusivity Period: 45 calendar days from execution.
Escrow Holdback: 12% of closing consideration held for 18 months.
Distribution: Restricted exclusively to General Counsel and authorized M&A committee members.
